# Test fixtures

JSON bodies as returned by `GET https://api-v3.amtraker.com/v3/trains/{id}` (`{"<number>": [train, …]}`)
or `GET …/v3/stations/{code}`. All of them were written by hand; none was captured from the live
API.

How the live server builds these objects is defined in
[`amtraker-v3/index.ts`](https://github.com/piemadd/amtraker-v3/blob/74789d05790d6b2f34b33044b6c9b5c3bba7041e/index.ts)
(`parseRawStation`, `parseDate`). Keep new fixtures consistent with it:

- every time is an ISO-8601 string with offset (`2026-02-08T07:25:00-05:00`), never epoch milliseconds;
- stop `status` is `Departed`, `Station` or `Enroute`, and **every** stop not yet reached is `Enroute`;
- for a stop not yet reached, `dep` equals the arrival estimate (`dep ?? arr`);
- `schArr`/`schDep` fall back to each other (origin and terminus have both);
- unknown train or station → `[]`.

| File | Follows upstream rules? | Scenario |
|---|---|---|
| `train_42_upstream_shape.json` | yes | Train 42 between Altoona and Huntingdon at 11:00; HBG has platform 3 |
| `train_171_northeast_regional.json` | yes | Train 171 BOS→WAS, departs PHL 15:30 (schedule), shares PHL and NYP with train 42 |
| `train_active_midjourney.json` | no: future stops have `status: ""` and `dep: null` | Train 42 between Altoona and Huntingdon |
| `train_cancelled_stops.json` | no | GBG `Cancelled`, LAT without times (cancelled-stop heuristic) |
| `train_completed.json` | no | All stops departed, `trainState: Completed` |
| `train_delayed_iso.json` | no | 15 min late, `statusMsg: "15 Minutes Late"` |
| `train_missing_fields.json` | no | `dep` key absent, `arr: null`, `bus: true`, platforms `5B`/`3A` |
| `train_multi_day.json` | no | Two trains under key `42` (today active, yesterday completed) |
| `train_predeparture.json` | no: upstream gives the origin `status: Station` and copies schedule into `arr`/`dep` | `trainState: Predeparture` |
| `train_space_statusmsg.json` | no | `statusMsg: " "` (what upstream sends for VIA, Brightline and CPKC trains) |
| `train_with_alerts.json` | no | Two `alerts` entries |
| `train_not_found.json` | yes | `[]` |
| `station_schedule.json` | yes | `/v3/stations/PHL`: metadata plus a list of train IDs, no times |
| `station_not_found.json` | yes | `[]` |

The two `upstream_shape`/`northeast_regional` files were generated by applying the rules above;
`generate_upstream_shape.py` regenerates them.
